message: Sensitive data logged — passwords, tokens, secrets must not appear in logs

evaluator_config.message_template: Sensitive data may be logged — sanitize before logging

rationale: Logs are stored, transmitted, and accessed by multiple systems. Sensitive data in logs creates a data leak vector that bypasses all access controls on the source system.
remediation: Sanitize sensitive fields before logging. Use redaction functions. Never log passwords, API keys, tokens, or secrets.

guidance.explanation: The correct version logs only the username, never the password. The incorrect version logs the password in plaintext, creating a data leak in log files.
